'''Pujin''' was an inquisitive old [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was traveling aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] when it was [[Attack on the Kuari Princess|attacked]] by the [[Riders of the Maelstrom]]. He had noticed the presence of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] aboard the vessel, who were there to guard the secret meeting between [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] [[Torpin]] and [[Vanko]], and unwittingly revealed that information to agents of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] over dinner.
